b: For its second season, Presumed Innocent has found the most combustible courtroom setup imaginable: opposing counsel who share a bed. Apple TV has released the teaser trailer for the anthology series’s latest installment, along with a premiere date of February 19, 2027.

The eight-episode season leaves Scott Turow’s Rusty Sabich behind and adapts Dissection of a Murder, the debut legal thriller from Jo Murray, who serves as a co-executive producer. Defense attorney Leila Reynolds (Rachel Brosnahan) faces off against her district attorney husband (Matthew Rhys) in a murder case that threatens to destroy both their careers and their marriage.

Courtney B. Vance, Fiona Shaw, Jack Reynor, and Lesley-Ann Brandt round out the cast, with Judith Light as a special guest star. David E. Kelley, who developed the series, returns as showrunner and executive produces with J.J. Abrams. Brosnahan is also an executive producer, and Jake Gyllenhaal, who led the first season, stays on as an EP.
